p-series.def: A series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^p}$. It converges if $p > 1$ and diverges if $p \le 1$, which the integral test proves.

harmonic-series.def: The $p$-series with $p = 1$, $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n}$, which diverges although its terms approach 0. The alternating harmonic series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n}$ converges.
